title: em9305 AUX/seti observability, 310aa8 MMIO paths, typed tail/radio rodata, typo-window shims, private p-tailshim paired sims
reason: Make the stock_306924 and stock_310aa8 typo-site mutants observable, type the 0x3357e0 tail and proved radio/small rodata, typo leftover residual/RF typo-window slots, then one private pbuild plus both paired sims.
object_count_note: Unchanged. em9305_ram_805e6c +4 gained a u32_805e70 union (stock_333404 word-loads that slot as a callback pointer) without adding or growing an object.

stock_306924.diagnosis: typo-vs-stock was already EQUIVALENT 100. The leftover r0 after seti is (u8_80fb78 & 0x0f) | 0x10 and already differed for the mutant, but nor0 discards ret for this void function. AUX sr/lr of SELECT (1035/0x40b), banked PRIORITY (518/0x206), ENABLE (1036/0x40c), and seti/clri were not rewritten or hashed, so memhash only saw random RAM fill.
stock_306924.harness: osub in build/em-ctl/qm.py now models those aux and seti/clri as RAM (SELECT 0xfff018, ENABLE 0xfff01c, seti/status 0xfff020, spill 0xfff024/0xfff028, banked PRIORITY table at 0xfff100 indexed by select & 0xff). Immediate sr goes through a spilled register (ARC st cannot take two long immediates; st 51,[0xfff018] failed to assemble). JLI_BASE sr 2093056,[656] is not rewritten. driver.c zeroes and hashes the model cells after every test, including void/nor0 units. 1409/1411 path unchanged.

rerun.mut_resid_cfg: KILLED: MISMATCH memhash:94(t=[0, 1, 2]) classes=16. The u32_80fb7c/u8_80fb78 mutant is now observable.

stock_310aa8.diagnosis: Both timer < 3 and timer >= 3 already occurred under random u8_80fd34, but classes is unique (ret, callhash) only. leftover r0 is always 512 and there are no calls, so classes stayed 1. The saved-pointer mutant only changed values stored to unhashed 0xf018xx MMIO.

The global class metric was not expanded to include memhash.
